description: The OWASP project that publishes the Top 10 for LLM Applications, the Top 10 for Agentic Applications and related guides.
Risks of applications built around a model. Current edition 2026 (August 2026); the 2025 edition is still widely cited, with different ids.
The Top 10 for Agentic Applications for 2026 (December 2025): risks of systems that plan and act, ids ASI01 to ASI10.
LLM08 in 2026 (System Prompt Leakage in 2025): anything the user does not see, from instructions to tool schemas, can be extracted.
ASI01: content the agent reads redirects its objective or plan; the agentic face of prompt injection.
Give an agent only the tools, permissions and autonomy its task needs: least privilege applied to agents.
ASI09: agents persuading or fatiguing people into approving unsafe actions.
